from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792544931/attempts/5b17e8f43661473aad6b536871505fc9/system/state/workspace/programs/task-9b993b09.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    clockwise = [[grid[n - 1 - j][i] for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)]
    counterclockwise = [[grid[j][n - 1 - i] for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)]
    half_turn = [row[::-1] for row in grid[::-1]]
    return [grid[i] + clockwise[i] for i in range(n)] + [counterclockwise[i] + half_turn[i] for i in range(n)]
'''
p.write_text(source)
exec(compile(source,str(p),'exec'),globals())
test=[[8,7,7],[2,7,5],[6,3,4]]
ans=transform(test)
print(ans)
